Dataocean AI / Speechocean

org.speechocean

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Current provider documentation received separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI content reviews for the exact imported observations. The commercial offer includes off-the-shelf datasets, custom collection/labeling, speech transcription, multimodal data and annotation tooling. Catalog descriptions are not independently licensed or reviewed as dataset families in this pass. Separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews are complete for the exact imported observations. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes are retained; no operational audit, commercial quality endorsement or automatic review of mentioned benchmarks is implied.
